name: Dependency Updater
description: Automatically checks for outdated dependencies in a project.

environment_variables.name: PROJECT_PATH
environment_variables.description: Path to the project directory to check for dependencies

environment_variables.name: UPDATE_MODE
environment_variables.description: Mode of operation: 'report' (default) to only report outdated dependencies, 'suggest' to suggest update commands, 'interactive' to prompt before suggesting updates

environment_variables.name: PACKAGE_FILTER
environment_variables.description: Optional filter to check specific packages only (comma-separated list, e.g., 'react,lodash')
